privacyConfirmBody_delete: Consultation data in Asinu will be deleted. The specialist system keeps anonymized records and an activity trail. This cannot be undone.

reminderAssistant.title: Tell Asinu when to remind you
reminderAssistant.hint: Say or type your morning, afternoon and evening times in one request.
reminderAssistant.placeholder: For example: 7:30 am, 2 pm and 9:30 pm.
reminderAssistant.unchanged: Your current reminder times already match your request.
reminderAssistant.clarify: Which reminder should change, and to what morning, afternoon or evening time?
reminderAssistant.scope: Here Asinu can change your daily morning, afternoon and evening reminders.
reminderAssistant.tooLong: This request is a little long. Start a new request with the times you want to change.
reminderAssistant.error: Could not confirm the result. Check your current times and tap Set my reminder times to retry.
reminderAssistant.conflict: Reminder times changed. Review the current schedule and send your request again.
reminderAssistant.expired: This request expired. Send it again so Asinu can check your current times.
reminderAssistant.rateLimited: Please wait a moment before trying again.
